card.name: The word existing after pre
card.fires_on: The word "existing" (or "-ING" in capitals) right after "pre" or "pre-", as in pre-existing conditions. It appears in warnings and dosing headings.

modes.label: pre-existing condition
modes.description: The ending of "pre-existing" before a condition such as hypertension, psychosis or renal impairment.
modes.example: Dosage Modification for Pre-<<Existing>> Severe Renal Impairment The

card.plain: It lights up on the "existing" in "pre-existing" when a label mentions a condition the patient already had.
